summary: Configured inventory-worker on node1 and verified it persists across a full node restart.
actions_performed: Created the locked inventorysvc system account with no home and a nologin shell.
Installed a validated systemd unit executing /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker as inventorysvc.
Restarted node1 safely and confirmed its boot identity changed.
Verified the service automatically recovered with its process UID/GID matching inventorysvc.

evidence.requirement: Run os-comparison-worker as the managed inventory-worker service under the dedicated inventorysvc account
evidence.summary: Shows the dedicated account, validated unit configuration, enabled/active service, exact ExecStart, and live process UID/GID 987:987 matching inventorysvc.

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart and recovery sequence
evidence.summary: Captures the healthy pre-restart baseline, acknowledged native reboot, boot ID change from 93dd959e-d32f-4398-8e14-61f8933af912 to 0d4e8550-f294-4005-aff9-a5c9ad3a1259, and passing post-restart assertions showing the service enabled, active, and running as inventorysvc.
